overall_reason: Every section is the stock SaaS template in the violet-gradient look: AI pill, gradient-word headline, a styled-div dashboard mock, a fake logo strip, three emoji icon cards, an unsourced stat band, three pricing tiers with 'Most Popular', a gradient CTA band and a link-farm footer with a newsletter box.

findings.evidence: T-STOCK-ORDER, 9 stock sections in stock order: (1) hero with product mock, (2) logo strip 'TRUSTED BY FAST-MOVING TEAMS AT', (3) three equal feature cards, (4) stat band, (5) three pricing tiers, (6) closing CTA band 'Ready to get started?', (7) link-farm footer with 4 columns, (8) newsletter sign-up 'STAY IN THE LOOP', (9) social icon row. Seven or more means generated regardless of copy.
findings.before: hero → logos → 3 features → stats → 3 tiers → CTA band → footer
findings.after: Rebuild from the product's real material: lead with one real Cadence chart on real event data and the question it answers [DATA NEEDED: a real screenshot and the customer question it answers]; cut the logo strip, stat band and CTA band
findings.why: The skeleton is the default output for 'SaaS landing page'.

findings.where: hero, buttons, stat band, CTA band
findings.evidence: violet-gradient family, at least 4 tells visible: indigo-to-violet/pink fills (logo tile, 'Start for free', 'Get Started', 'Start free trial', CTA band), gradient text on 'just works' and on all four stat figures, a soft radial violet glow behind the hero and under the mock and pro card, and scattered radii (pill badge, 12px buttons, 16px cards, 24px CTA band).
findings.before: linear-gradient(indigo → violet/pink) on fills and text
findings.after: One solid accent taken from the brand [DATA NEEDED: brand colour], no gradient text, no glow shadows
findings.why: SLP-162/163/164: the AI-purple gradient is the most recognised generated look.

findings.evidence: A 'dashboard' built from grey placeholder bars and six gradient columns with no axis, labels or values, in a glowing frame. Failed T-DELETION and T-FILLER: it shows no real product and no data.
findings.before: styled-div bar chart in a lavender frame
findings.after: A real Cadence screenshot (funnel or retention view) with real labels [DATA NEEDED: product capture]
findings.why: Imitation product UI stands in for the product the page is selling (IMG-105).

findings.evidence: Logo strip lists 'Northwind', 'Lumen', 'Vertex', 'Quanta', 'Beacon', 'Atlas' set as grey text: default fake brands (Northwind is Microsoft's sample-database company). Stat band '12,000+ Teams onboard', '8B Events / month', '4.9★ Average rating', '99.99% Uptime SLA' has no source; 'Join thousands of teams' repeats it.
findings.before: TRUSTED BY FAST-MOVING TEAMS AT Northwind Lumen Vertex …
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: real customer logos with permission, and sourced figures], or remove both sections
findings.why: Invented customers and metrics are false proof (INT-001, INT-007).

findings.evidence: h1 'Product analytics that just works'; lede '…ship with confidence instead of guesswork. Seamlessly powerful, beautifully simple.'; 'Everything you need to understand your users'; 'Powerful features that scale with your team'; 'Simple, transparent pricing'; 'Ready to get started?'. Failed T-RIVAL-NAME: Mixpanel, Amplitude or PostHog can say every one. Failed T-FRESH-READER: all six are the generic lines.
findings.after: A head only Cadence can say, from a real differentiator [DATA NEEDED: what Cadence does that Mixpanel/Amplitude do not]
findings.why: Stock phrases and slop words (seamlessly, powerful) in every heading.

findings.where: 'Powered by AI' pill, feature cards, footer social row
findings.evidence: Emoji used as icons: ✨ in the 'Powered by AI' pill, 📊 ⚡ 🚀 in lavender rounded tiles above each feature heading, and 🐦/💼/🐙-style emoji as the footer social links.
findings.before: 📊 Live dashboards / ⚡ Funnels & retention / 🚀 Team workspaces
findings.after: Delete the icon tiles and the pill; use proper SVG brand marks with labels for social links
findings.why: Emoji icons in filled tiles combine SLP-013, SLP-140 and SLP-139.

findings.evidence: Pill label above the headline ('✨ Powered by AI'), accented gradient words in the h1 ('just works'), centred everything, primary with glued arrow 'Start for free →' beside a stock second action 'Book a demo' (SLP-201, SLP-224).
findings.before: pill + gradient-word h1 + centred lede + two buttons
findings.after: Left-aligned head with no pill and no accented word; one primary action without the arrow glyph
findings.why: Each is a hero-template tell; together they are the template.

strengths: Pricing tiers state concrete limits (5k events, 7-day history, 1M events, 1-year history), which is the only falsifiable content on the page.
not_investigated: image-only item: no DOM, CSS or fonts, so computed values (exact hex, radii, fonts) are read from the picture, not measured
motion and hover states: not visible in a still
